github.description: Abandoned in 2017. Resurrected in 2026 by a madman: bigt92. BUSMASTER-NG, the CAN/LIN analyzer you love, now with a modern build, crisp icons and zero Windows XP. Community fork under LGPL, not affiliated with ETAS/Bosch.
The agent can't claim the firmware works — until the board says so. Hardware-in-the-loop verification gate: build → flash → boot banner → exit code.
Open-source browser-based CAN log viewer. Load BLF/ASC/CSV/MF4 and DBC, decode locally, then inspect signals on Graph, frames on Trace, and databases on DBC.

Lightweight browser-based CAN trace plotting and analysis GUI.
An unofficial Android port of Blue Dragon (Xbox 360), focused on performance, compatibility, bug fixes, and an improved user experience.
